targets.query:
SELECT (last("sum_last_pnl")) as PNL
FROM (
    SELECT SUM(last_pnl) AS sum_last_pnl FROM (
        SELECT last("pnl") AS last_pnl 
        FROM "default"."acct_lvl_daily_pnl"
        WHERE ("level" =~ /^1$/) AND "label" !~ /^SLN--DEFI$/ 
        AND $timeFilter
        GROUP BY time($__interval), "label", "level"
    ) 
    GROUP BY time($__interval)
)

from(bucket: "Mimid_PnLStatsTestNew")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "acct_lvl_daily_trade_vol")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "trade_vol")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["level"] == "0")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: $__interval, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "last")

panels.title: Daily PnL by Mimid Account Level ${level}

targets.query:
from(bucket: "Mimid_PnLStatsTestNew")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "acct_lvl_daily_pnl")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "pnl")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["level"] =~ /^(${level:pipe})$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["label"] =~ /^(${label:pipe})$/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: $__interval, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> difference()
  |> cumulativeSum()
  |> yield(name: "last")
